goal: Stop AddrMan from wrongly punishing addresses on a network just because a different network succeeded
Fixes IPv6/Tor/I2P peers being marked bad and evicted due to unrelated successful connections on IPv4
reviewability: Ready to review now, no CI failures or rebase needed, author has replied to latest comments
agreement: Strong concept support with independent bug confirmation via logs (naiyoma)
Concept ACK without detailed reasons (fjahr, brunoerg)
Nonblocking objection: unreachable-network addresses may linger uselessly in addrman (stratospher)
Author accepted the lingering-address tradeoff rather than fixing it, suggesting -onlynet as workaround

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a real, confirmed bug causing wrongful eviction of good peers
Particularly benefits users relying on privacy-sensitive transports like Tor and I2P with partial connectivity
Not consensus-critical and doesn't unblock other major work, so impact is meaningful but not critical
